title: Ptidej
summary: A Java-based tool suite (Ptidej Tool Suite) for detecting and evaluating design patterns and architectural quality in object-oriented programs, developed by the Ptidej Team. The matched files belong to the bundled third-party 'SDMetricsOpenCore' UML metrics library, unrelated to the SDV-family sdmetrics package.
evidence: PADL Creator XMI/lib/SDMetricsOpenCore/src/com/sdmetrics - a UML design-metrics tool, not SDV's sdmetrics
needs: Confirm SDMetricsOpenCore is unrelated to SDV's sdmetrics package (it is a separate UML metrics tool by Juergen Wuest).
